svg.text: How the reasoning model's performance will be understood
The system under test on the upper band; what its answers are scored against on the lower one. Built; the benchmark runs come after the acceptance story.
node gate, verify with repair rounds,
every switch is an arm file
cost per chain on the same row
an abstention is never a positive;
verifier catch rate and rounds to valid
and with the verifier's own label
where a stack spends its capacity, not only whether it won
single call against the staged loop
cheap executor under a strong verifier
every table with its run id and the store snapshot it read; no human rater in the prototype, so the mechanical tiers, the gate suite and second-reader agreement stand in, each with its denominator
packs are built from the frozen cells
each arm runs the loop with one switch changed
dashed box: built, runs pending until the benchmark is finished
the boundary a number cannot cross without a stored value behind it
dashed arrow: traces and switches, not data
